messages.text: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
The passages do not give a formal standalone definition of “non-signaling tester,” but they support describing it as a tester used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode, especially production RF testing where measurements are run without signaling/protocol operation to save time [65][100].  
### What it means
Non-signaling is tied to RF testing, while signaling is tied to protocol testing in the raw source wording “Non-signaling - RF” and “Signaling - Protocol” [100].  
In WLAN device production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time [65].  
R&S CMP180 is positioned for production non-signaling RF testing in the Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing context [8][65].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on it
| Decision | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Whether to use production non-signaling RF testing or R&D signaling testing | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing uses R&S CMX500 for signaling / interworking testing, while production uses R&S CMP180 for non-signaling RF testing [8]. |
| Whether the measurement is RF-only or protocol/application/signaling-oriented | The value chain lists Non-signaling RF separately from Signaling Protocol, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance and conformance testing [4]. |
| Whether CMP180 is the relevant production tester | CMP180 is described as a radio communication tester for production / wireless communication device testing [1]. |
| Whether CMP180 can cover the needed production RF architecture | CMP180 supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and provides RF generator/analyzer no. 1 plus optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2 in a multi-port RF test architecture [2]. |
| How many RF ports / benches are needed | CMP180 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 has 8 × SnapN RF input/output ports RF 1.1 to RF 1.8, and RF generator/analyzer no. 2 has 8 × SnapN RF input/output ports RF 2.1 to RF 2.8 [32]. |
| Whether a second CMP180 TRX / connector bench is needed | CMP180 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 requires R&S CMP-K102 or R&S CMP-K105 software license key [32][58]. |
| Whether the frequency requirement exceeds 6 GHz | CMP180 basic RF generator/analyzer frequency range is 400 MHz to 6000 MHz, and R&S CMP-K168 extends the range from 6000 MHz to 8000 MHz [33][96]. |
| Whether the bandwidth requirement is 250 MHz or 500 MHz | CMP180 IF bandwidth is 250 MHz basic and reaches 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [33]. |
| Whether the RF unit supports the desired bandwidth upgrade | R&S CMP-B802x supports only 250 MHz bandwidth, while R&S CMP-B805x supports 250 MHz and can use R&S CMP-K185 to enable 500 MHz [58]. |
| Whether 2x2 or 4x4 MIMO production testing is in scope | The Wi‑Fi 7 production source says CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports to support 2x2 MIMO testing in one box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [65]. |
| Whether to use CMX500 instead for signaling or broader protocol/application workflows | CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [10]. |
| Whether CMX500 non-signaling use cases are relevant in R&D | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a CMX500 non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [16]. |
【推論】Understanding “non-signaling tester” affects product choice because the passages place CMP180 in production non-signaling RF testing and CMX500 in signaling / network-emulation testing [8][10][65].

passages.text:
R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

5G device testing value chain › 測試類型
來源列出的測試類型包含：

- [[RF]]。
- [[Signaling]]。
- [[Application testing]]。
- [[OTA testing]]。
- [[Pre-conformance testing]]。
- [[Conformance approval]]。
- [[Carrier acceptance]]。
- [[Non-signaling RF]]。
- [[Signaling Protocol]]。
- [[Service and repair]]。

5G device testing value chain › Manufacturing 目標
來源指出 manufacturing 測試目標包含：

- High yield of devices with high quality。
- Achieve shortest test time possible；time = money。
- Characterize and optimize parametric RF transceiver sub systems。
- Debug and trace。

來源列出的 manufacturing / production 相關工具包含 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] for signaling 與 [[R&S CMQ]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

- Easy to test with。

CMX500 Callbox

R&S CMW100 K06 › 規格資料的使用限制
[[CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500]] 對規格類型定義如下：

- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 保證。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；Subject to change。

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

### Short answer
The passages do not give a formal standalone definition of “non-signaling tester,” but they support describing it as a tester used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode, especially production RF testing where measurements are run without signaling/protocol operation to save time [65][100].  
### What it means
Non-signaling is tied to RF testing, while signaling is tied to protocol testing in the raw source wording “Non-signaling - RF” and “Signaling - Protocol” [100].  
In WLAN device production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time [65].  
R&S CMP180 is positioned for production non-signaling RF testing in the Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing context [8][65].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on it
| Decision | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Whether to use production non-signaling RF testing or R&D signaling testing | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing uses R&S CMX500 for signaling / interworking testing, while production uses R&S CMP180 for non-signaling RF testing [8]. |
| Whether the measurement is RF-only or protocol/application/signaling-oriented | The value chain lists Non-signaling RF separately from Signaling Protocol, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance and conformance testing [4]. |
| Whether CMP180 is the relevant production tester | CMP180 is described as a radio communication tester for production / wireless communication device testing [1]. |
| Whether CMP180 can cover the needed production RF architecture | CMP180 supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and provides RF generator/analyzer no. 1 plus optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2 in a multi-port RF test architecture [2]. |
| How many RF ports / benches are needed | CMP180 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 has 8 × SnapN RF input/output ports RF 1.1 to RF 1.8, and RF generator/analyzer no. 2 has 8 × SnapN RF input/output ports RF 2.1 to RF 2.8 [32]. |
| Whether a second CMP180 TRX / connector bench is needed | CMP180 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 requires R&S CMP-K102 or R&S CMP-K105 software license key [32][58]. |
| Whether the frequency requirement exceeds 6 GHz | CMP180 basic RF generator/analyzer frequency range is 400 MHz to 6000 MHz, and R&S CMP-K168 extends the range from 6000 MHz to 8000 MHz [33][96]. |
| Whether the bandwidth requirement is 250 MHz or 500 MHz | CMP180 IF bandwidth is 250 MHz basic and reaches 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [33]. |
| Whether the RF unit supports the desired bandwidth upgrade | R&S CMP-B802x supports only 250 MHz bandwidth, while R&S CMP-B805x supports 250 MHz and can use R&S CMP-K185 to enable 500 MHz [58]. |
| Whether 2x2 or 4x4 MIMO production testing is in scope | The Wi‑Fi 7 production source says CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports to support 2x2 MIMO testing in one box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [65]. |
| Whether to use CMX500 instead for signaling or broader protocol/application workflows | CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [10]. |
| Whether CMX500 non-signaling use cases are relevant in R&D | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a CMX500 non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [16]. |
【推論】Understanding “non-signaling tester” affects product choice because the passages place CMP180 in production non-signaling RF testing and CMX500 in signaling / network-emulation testing [8][10][65].

這份來源是 [[R&S CMP180]] **Radio Communication Tester** 的 specifications 文件，文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期標示 **March 2026**；封面與頁尾皆標示 **Version 08.00**。來源頁尾標示 **© 2021–2026 Rohde & Schwarz**，並聲明 **Data without tolerance limits is not binding**、**Subject to change**。

本規格書補足 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 所未提供的 binding specifications、base unit order number、RF unit order number、RF generator/analyzer 規格、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service 資訊。

主要重點：

- [[R&S CMP180]] base unit order no.：**1201.0002K18**，包含 power cables 與 getting started guide。
- 文件版次：**PD 3609.7348.22 | Version 08.00 | March 2026 (ch)**。
- RF generator/analyzer 頻率範圍：基本 **400 MHz to 6000 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K168** 可擴展到 **6000 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- 搭配 **R&S CMP-B805I** 與 **R&S CMP-K168** 時，generator overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8250 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8000 MHz**；analyzer overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8500 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8250 MHz**。
- 每個 RF generator/analyzer connector bench 有 **8 × SnapN** RF input/output to DUT；第二組 TRX / RF 2.1 to RF 2.8 需 **R&S CMP-K102** 或 **R&S CMP-K105** software license key。
- IF bandwidth：基本 **250 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K185** 可達 **500 MHz**，且 ordering information 明示 only available if **R&S CMP-B805I or higher option** is installed。
- ARB memory：**8 Gbyte/channel**；sample length up to **800 Msample**；maximum sample rate **312.5 MHz**，搭配 **R&S CMP-K185** 為 **625 MHz**。
- Calibration interval：**24 months**；base unit warranty：**1 year**。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。
